page.overview:
Who is Candy Person 203?

Kenneth looks like a pink-frosted donut with rainbow sprinkles only in "Five Short Graybles" and looks like a cream-frosted donut with rainbow sprinkles. His arms are at the side of the donut and his face is on the front of the frosting, unlike Dr. Donut.
